## Local video generation

Open **Video**, describe a scene, choose a frame and clip length, and select **Generate video**. Short silent MP4s are generated locally with the connected workspace’s installed Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B model. The three frame options are landscape, portrait and square. Clip lengths are 1, 2 and 4 seconds. Play the result in the app or save an MP4 copy.

On an RTX 3060 with 12 GB of VRAM, the packaged desktop app generated a two-second, 512 × 288 clip at 16 fps in 36.9 seconds of worker time. The preview played and the saved MP4 matched the verified render. This benchmark includes engine startup and encoding. Other hardware and longer clips will have different render times.

A separate Windows-path regression generated a one-second portrait clip in 31.9 seconds and a four-second square clip in 56.7 seconds. Both files decoded fully at their requested sizes. The worker closed its model process and discarded intermediate files after each render.

19 native video tests passed. The composer and recovery checks covered saved prompts, request deduplication and the shared audio editor. Two optional native tests were ignored by the test harness.
